capabilities: Type readable .zyxd lines that render as a drawing
Drag shapes on the canvas and rewrite only the changed numbers
Draw and edit paths, curves, polygons and points
Define reusable custom shapes in .zyxdl library files
Export to SVG, PNG or an Obsidian canvas
extras: Works offline and sends nothing anywhere; ships a one-page language guide meant to be given to AI assistants, and drawings stay as plain text files in the vault.
motivation: Built as a quick drawing tool for people taking notes, explicitly not meant to replace other drawing, diagram or design tools.
problem: Drawing diagrams in Obsidian usually means either a closed binary format or hand-writing raw SVG markup.
summary: Text-based vector drawing editor that keeps a typed .zyxd file and a mouse-edited canvas in step, and exports plain SVG.
